200.description: TikTok videos for the requested profile.

lookupStatus.description: Whether videos could be listed for this handle: `found` (the list may still be empty), `private` (the account is private, so no videos are visible) or `not_found` (no such account). Treat unknown values like `not_found`.

caption.description: Caption text shown for the TikTok video.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the video was created, when available.

url.description: Canonical public TikTok URL for the video.

thumbnailUrl.description: Source-platform CDN thumbnail or cover URL when available. It can expire or be rejected outside the original retrieval context; it is not a SocialFetch-hosted asset.

durationMs.description: Video duration in milliseconds, when available.

pinned.description: Whether the video is pinned on the profile.

isAd.description: Whether TikTok marks the video as an ad.

views.description: View count reported by TikTok for the video.

likes.description: Like count reported by TikTok for the video.

comments.description: Comment count reported by TikTok for the video.

shares.description: Share count reported by TikTok for the video.

saves.description: Save or collection count reported by TikTok for the video.

downloadUrl.description: Source-platform CDN download URL, usually with watermark, when available. It can expire or be rejected outside the original retrieval context; it is not a SocialFetch-hosted asset.

downloadWithoutWatermarkUrl.description: Source-platform CDN download URL without watermark when available. It can expire or be rejected outside the original retrieval context; it is not a SocialFetch-hosted asset. Preferred over the watermarked URL when both are present.

media.description: Download-related media URLs for the video.

details.description: Additional TikTok-native fields for this video (for example author, music, challenges, and full `video` and `statistics` objects). Keys that only duplicate the top-level fields are omitted.

status.description: Whether SocialFetch stored a durable copy of this asset.

role.description: Which source field this asset was derived from.

originalUrl.description: Original CDN URL that was requested for hosting. Still transient; prefer `url` when status is stored.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the stored file on the media CDN when status is stored. The link stays valid until the file is deleted at `retainedUntil`; save the file if you need it longer.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the returned URL stops working. Same as `retainedUntil`, because the link stays valid until the file is deleted.

retainedUntil.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the stored object is deleted from SocialFetch storage (90-day tier).

mime.description: MIME type of the stored bytes when status is stored.

bytes.description: Stored size in bytes when status is stored.

entityId.description: Opaque parent entity id for this asset (post, reel, photo, or video id).

postId.description: Legacy Instagram media id alias for `entityId`. Prefer `entityId`.

errorCode.description: Typed failure code when status is failed.

errorMessage.description: Short customer-safe failure message when status is failed.

items.description: SocialFetch-hosted original media asset or per-asset failure.

hostedMedia.description: Present only when `hostMedia=true`: durable hosted copies of the source media (the CDN URLs above can expire), and/or per-asset failures for this video.

items.description: TikTok video in the profile feed.

videos.description: TikTok videos for the requested profile page. Always empty when `lookupStatus` is `private` or `not_found`. With `found`, an empty array means no videos on this page (for example none in the selected sort window).

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass in the next request when more videos are available.

hasMore.description: Whether another page of videos is available.

page.description: Pagination state for the current response.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier for tracing this API call.

version.description: Public API version that served the response.

meta.description: Metadata describing the request and billing outcome.
